summation.displayName: Based on studies with the oncogenic NPM-ALK fusion, ALK is p...
summation.text: Based on studies with the oncogenic NPM-ALK fusion, ALK is predicted to signal through the PLC gamma signaling pathway. PLCG1 binds to phosphorylated tyrosine 1604 on the activated receptor. PLCG1 signaling contributes to mitogenesis and cellular proliferation downstream of ALK signaling (Bai et al, 1998; reviewed in Turner and Alexander, 2006; Chiarle et al, 2008).
